summary: ACRES Commercial Realty Corp. filed an 8-K on August 6, 2026, reporting entry into and termination of material definitive agreements, completion of an acquisition/disposition, creation of a direct financial obligation, unregistered sales of equity securities, and officer departures. No specific special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or strategic review is concretely described in the excerpt; the items suggest multiple transactions but lack explicit deal terms, pricing, or board recommendations.
